description: Figure 6, titled “Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution,” is a pie chart that visually represents the proportional distribution of token resolution outcomes across three distinct stages in the FedHLM framework. The chart is divided into three colored segments: a large light blue segment representing “Local (Client-side)” resolution, which accounts for 94.49% of tokens; a small green segment for “Edge P2P Exchange,” comprising 1.57%; and a narrow red segment for “LLM (Cloud)” resolution, making up 3.93%. The chart visually emphasizes that the vast majority of tokens are resolved locally at the client side, with minimal reliance on peer-to-peer exchanges or centralized cloud-based LLMs. Although the figure itself is rendered as a gray placeholder in the provided image, the accompanying Table III and textual description confirm these exact percentages and the hierarchical dominance of local resolution.
